speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: asked the Minister for Education what steps are taken to avoid discrimination on the basis of descent in our Primary school admission system which gives preference to children of alumni, given that Article 16(1)(a) of our Constitution provides that "there shall be no discrimination against any citizen of Singapore on the grounds only of religion, race, descent or place of birth in the administration of any educational institution maintained by a public authority, and, in particular, the admission of pupils...".

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: These are all valid justifications for some level of priority admission.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: It is common for MOE to receive arguments from one group on why the other group is less deserving.
